title: Reward-Adaptive Co-Evolution of Policy and Rubric
abstract: arXiv:2610.40096v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rubric-based rewards provide fine-grained, interpretable supervision for open-ended reinforcement learning, where holistic scalar rewards struggle to capture multidimensional response quality. Static rubrics can lose discriminative power as the policy distribution evolves, while existing policy--rubric co-evolution methods rely on globally prescribed update schedules that ignore heterogeneous reward informativeness. We introduce RACE, a Reward-Adaptive Co-Evolution framework. At the group level, per-rollout-group training-signal routing classifies groups as informative, diversity-collapsed, or rubric-failed, updating the policy only with informative groups while caching rubric failures. At the phase level, event-triggered phase switching enters rubric optimization upon persistent reward saturation and returns when rubric-reward improvement plateaus. Rubric phases train the generator on cached pairs using a frozen judge and a scale-normal

translated_title: 策略与评分准则的奖励自适应协同演化
translated_abstract: 基于评分准则的奖励为开放式强化学习提供了细粒度、可解释的监督信号，而整体性的标量奖励难以捕捉多维度的回复质量。静态的评分准则会随着策略分布的演化而丧失区分能力，而现有的策略—评分准则协同演化方法依赖于全局预设的更新调度，忽略了奖励信息量的异质性。我们提出了RACE，一个奖励自适应协同演化框架。在组级别，针对每个采样组的训练信号路由将各组分类为信息丰富型、多样性坍缩型或评分准则失败型，仅使用信息丰富的组来更新策略，同时缓存评分准则失败的样本。在阶段级别，事件触发的阶段切换机制在奖励持续饱和时进入评分准则优化阶段，并在评分准则—奖励的提升趋于平缓时返回原阶段。评分准则阶段利用冻结的评判模型和尺度归一化（方法）在缓存的样本对上训练生成器（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出RACE框架，通过组级训练信号路由（仅用信息丰富的采样组更新策略并缓存评分失败样本）和事件触发的阶段切换（奖励持续饱和时自动进入评分准则优化），实现了策略与评分准则的奖励自适应协同演化。
en_tdlr: RACE is a reward-adaptive co-evolution framework that routes training signals at the rollout-group level—updating the policy only with informative groups while caching rubric failures—and employs event-triggered phase switching to enter rubric optimization when rewards persistently saturate.
